fixed_station_study.recovery: Bilinear polynomial through four Gauss values inside each element; one-sided values averaged on shared edges; no cross-element smoothing. Parameter along exact analytic profile. Piecewise-exact integration in Y over fixed interval. Integral of each local component is diagnostic, not a global cut force or connector demand.
fixed_station_study.purpose: Diagnose moving sampling locations; does not supersede failed S2B peak criterion.

coupon.nu_zero_reason: Independent plane-stress/plane-strain coincident benchmark, not concrete material selection
coupon.solid_bc: Uy=0 at every node; theta=0 Uz=0 along full end face; one Ux datum at theta=0,r=Rm,Y=width/2. Radial faces free. This deliberately suppresses width/edge effects.
coupon.shell_bc: Uy=Rx=Rz=0 at every node; theta=0 Uz=Ry=0; one Ux datum at theta=0,Y=width/2. Same end moment resultant as solid.
coupon.load: No gravity. Solid theta=90 end: consistent nodal tractions from exact Airy sigma_theta; shell end: nodal My totaling -moment_per_width*width. Unit diagnostic moment is NOT a building design load.
coupon.reference: Airy phi=A ln(r)+B r^2 ln(r)+C r^2; sigma_rr=A/r^2+B(2ln(r)+1)+2C; sigma_tt=-A/r^2+B(2ln(r)+3)+2C. Solve sigma_rr(ri)=sigma_rr(ro)=0 and integral r*sigma_tt dr=1. Plane-strain energy from 3D Hooke law; sigma_yy=nu*(sigma_rr+sigma_tt).
coupon.comparison: Energy/compliance and through-thickness stress versus analytic elasticity; shell linear N/t +/- 6M/t^2 recovery is a model assumption, not concrete capacity. Not interchangeable boundary tractions through thickness.

qa_targets_declared_before_run.scope: Diagnostic numerical targets only, not code acceptance; preserve all failures

sources.title: NPTEL Chapter 10.3.1 — curved beam elasticity, equations 10.34–10.41
